mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tier_code, total_accumulated_points, current_period_points, period_start_date, upgrade_time, downgrade_time, create_time, update_time FROM mp_member_tier WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mp_member_tier (user_id, tier_code, total_accumulated_points, current_period_points, period_start_date, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tierCode}, #{totalAccumulatedPoints}, #{currentPeriodPoints}, #{periodStartDate}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mp_member_tier SET tier_code = #{tierCode}, upgrade_time = #{upgradeTime}, downgrade_time = #{downgradeTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE mp_member_tier SET total_accumulated_points = total_accumulated_points + #{points}, current_period_points = current_period_points + #{points}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
